name: King or Fail
summary: In this idle role-playing game you are both farmer and fighter, with sidelines in mining, crafting, construction and management too: you are a king, with a kingdom to protect, expand and develop. Start with just a small squad of swordsmen and a few berry trees, then get working to build a city, feed your people, raid enemy castles for resources and experience, expand your army and turn your tiny village into a flourishing and fearsome empire.
